clean.title: Backend Engineer
clean.text:
Backend Engineer at Tamween (Riyadh, hybrid)

Tamween builds ordering and delivery software for grocery retailers in Saudi Arabia.

What we ask for
- 3+ years of experience building backend services
- Strong knowledge of Node.js or Python
- Experience with Postgres and Kafka in production

Nice to have
- Experience with Kubernetes

We offer visa sponsorship and relocation support. This is a full-time position.

clean.title: Senior Platform Engineer
clean.text:
Senior Platform Engineer at Qafila (Dubai, on-site)

Qafila moves freight across the Gulf. The platform team runs the services that every other team builds on.

Requirements
- 6+ years of experience running production systems
- Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform
- Strong programming skills in Go or Python
- Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus or Datadog

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka

This is a full-time position based in our Dubai office. We sponsor work visas for this role.

clean.title: AI Engineer
clean.text:
AI Engineer (Remote, MENA) at Sanad

Sanad builds assistants for customer support teams in Arabic and English.

What you will do
Design agent flows, write evaluations and ship them with the platform team.

What we are looking for
- 3+ years of professional experience with Python
- Hands-on experience building LLM applications with LangGraph or LangChain
- Experience writing evaluations for model outputs
- Fluency in Arabic and English is required

Bonus
- Experience with FastAPI

Contract role, fully remote within the MENA region. We are not able to sponsor visas.
